ATOMIC — LAUNCH PRESS KIT
Prepared 29 October 2026 | Launch: Tuesday, 3 November 2026

Open index.html for an offline catalogue with previews and download links.
Read 01-documents/00-complete-press-book.pdf for the complete editorial pack.
Individual documents are supplied in PDF, DOCX, HTML and plain text. PDF, HTML and editable Word documents include selected product imagery.

01-documents — Product, company, launch announcement, facts, team bios, FAQ, brand guide, captions, video guide and social copy.
02-logos — Outlined SVG, vector PDF and transparent PNG; colour, black and white.
03-screenshots — Polished product gallery, clean captures in raw/, and caption/context files.
04-portraits — Founder and team portraits at their supplied resolutions.
05-video — Square and vertical teasers, plus 35-second launch films in widescreen, square and vertical formats, and subtitles.
06-social — Square and vertical cover artwork.

All product screens show local sample apps and data. The builder conversation is staged; the annotation composer is an unsent draft. Billing usage and allowances are illustrative.
The longer demo shows local sample-app interactions.
